# Code generated by Termwright. DO NOT EDIT - Termwright writes this file again when tests are saved.
#
# Runs the generated TCL tests:  tclsh lib/tcl/run_tests.tcl ?folders or files? ?-junit junit.xml?
# TW_TESTBED=testbeds/lab.yaml and TW_VAR_<name>=<value> set {{variables}}.

set root [file dirname [file dirname [file dirname [file normalize [info script]]]]]
set junit ""
set paths {}
for {set i 0} {$i < [llength $argv]} {incr i} {
    set a [lindex $argv $i]
    if {$a eq "-junit" || $a eq "--junit"} { set junit [lindex $argv [incr i]] } else { lappend paths $a }
}
if {![llength $paths]} { set paths [list [file join $root cases]] }

proc walk {d} {
    set out [lsort [glob -nocomplain -type f -directory $d *.test.tcl]]
    foreach s [lsort [glob -nocomplain -type d -directory $d *]] { lappend out {*}[walk $s] }
    return $out
}

set files {}
foreach p $paths { if {[file isdirectory $p]} { lappend files {*}[walk $p] } else { lappend files $p } }

proc esc {s} { string map {& &amp; < &lt; > &gt; \" &quot;} $s }

set bad 0
set cases {}
foreach f $files {
    set t0 [clock milliseconds]
    set rc [catch {exec [info nameofexecutable] $f 2>@1} out opts]
    set ms [expr {[clock milliseconds] - $t0}]
    puts "== $f"
    puts $out
    set failed [expr {$rc != 0}]
    if {$failed} { incr bad }
    lappend cases [list $f $failed $ms $out]
}
puts [format "%d test files, %d failed" [llength $files] $bad]
if {$junit ne ""} {
    set x "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<testsuite name=\"termwright\" tests=\"[llength $cases]\" failures=\"$bad\">\n"
    foreach c $cases {
        lassign $c f failed ms out
        append x "  <testcase classname=\"[esc [file rootname [file rootname [file tail $f]]]]\" name=\"[esc $f]\" time=\"[format %.3f [expr {$ms/1000.0}]]\">"
        if {$failed} { append x "<failure message=\"failed\">[esc $out]</failure>" }
        append x "</testcase>\n"
    }
    append x "</testsuite>\n"
    set fh [open $junit w]; puts -nonewline $fh $x; close $fh
}
exit [expr {$bad > 0}]
